name: Dubai
tagline: Zero Income Tax, World-Class Luxury, and Year-Round Sunshine
description: Dubai offers a unique FIRE proposition: zero income tax on your withdrawals combined with world-class infrastructure, safety, and connectivity. The city is a global hub with direct flights to virtually everywhere, a cosmopolitan expat community, and amenities that range from futuristic skyscrapers to pristine beaches. While the cost of living is higher than most FIRE destinations, the tax savings can offset this significantly for high-net-worth retirees.

quickFacts.visa: Multiple residency options: 10-year Golden Visa for property investment (AED 2M+), 5-year retirement visa (requirements apply), or freelancer/remote work visas
quickFacts.language: Arabic (official); English is the lingua franca and widely spoken everywhere
quickFacts.safetyRating: Very High – one of the safest cities in the world; extremely low crime
quickFacts.nearestAirport: Dubai International Airport (DXB) – world's busiest international airport
quickFacts.climate: Hot desert with very hot, humid summers (40°C+) and mild, pleasant winters

housing.description: Studio in an outer community (Discovery Gardens / JVC / Al Nahda / International City)

healthcare.description: Basic DHA-compliant individual plan (mandatory for a residence visa)

transportation.description: Nol monthly pass + occasional taxi (no car)

entertainment.description: Basic gym + occasional cinema; free beach/malls

1M.lifestyle: Frugal living in an expensive city — a studio in an outer community like Discovery Gardens or JVC, the Metro and the occasional taxi instead of a car, and Dubai's excellent, affordable South-Asian and shawarma spots supplemented by home cooking. The legally required basic health plan is covered. The beach is free and the malls are air-conditioned refuges, but most of the Dubai people imagine stays out of reach. This is tight, disciplined living where rent and summer cooling dominate the budget.

housing.description: 1BR apartment in Dubai Marina, JLT, or Business Bay with city or partial marina views

dining.description: Mid-range dining 3-4x/week; enjoying Dubai's diverse international restaurant scene

healthcare.description: Comprehensive health insurance with good hospital network and reasonable deductibles

transportation.description: Compact car rental or owned vehicle, fuel, Salik tolls, parking, insurance

entertainment.description: Beach clubs on occasion, gym membership, desert trips, cinema, brunches

2M.lifestyle: A more comfortable footing — a proper 1-bedroom in JLT or Business Bay, a car for getting around with Salik tolls and parking, and a comprehensive health plan. Mid-range dining a few times a week and the occasional weekend brunch fit the budget. Zero income tax helps, but Dubai remains costly and this level is comfortable rather than plush.

housing.description: Good 1BR (or compact 2BR) in the Marina / Downtown-adjacent

transportation.description: Mid-range SUV all-in (fuel + Salik + insurance + parking)

3M.lifestyle: This is where Dubai starts to feel like the brochure — a good 1-bedroom in the Marina or Downtown-adjacent, regular dining including hotel brunches, a mid-range SUV, and premium health cover with access to top hospitals. Beach-club season, desert weekends, and Dubai Opera nights are all within reach. The tax-free setting stretches the budget meaningfully against a comparable Western city.

housing.description: Luxury 3BR penthouse in Downtown Dubai, or a villa on Palm Jumeirah with private beach

dining.description: Fine dining at Michelin-starred restaurants multiple times per week, catered dinner parties

healthcare.description: VIP health insurance with direct access to top specialists, executive wellness programs

transportation.description: Luxury vehicle (Mercedes, Range Rover), premium insurance, private driver for events

entertainment.description: Premium beach and yacht clubs, golf at Emirates Golf Club, VIP event access, spa retreats

domesticHelp.description: Full-time live-in maid, regular deep cleaning service, driver on call

luxuryExtras.description: Yacht charter weekends, first-class travel, designer shopping, Maldives getaways

5M.lifestyle: An affluent Dubai lifestyle — a luxury apartment or small villa in a prime waterfront district, near-daily fine dining, and part-time household help. A premium car, worldwide (ex-US) health cover, and a healthy budget for clubs, travel, and leisure. Life is genuinely upscale here, though Dubai's high costs mean even this budget has visible edges.

housing.description: Prime Palm Jumeirah apartment / Downtown penthouse

transportation.description: Luxury car running/fuel/Salik/valet (chauffeur salary in domesticHelp)

domesticHelp.description: Live-in maid + chauffeur (+ cook), incl. visa/overhead

luxuryExtras.description: Charters, first-class travel share, luxury shopping

10M.lifestyle: Top-of-market Dubai — a prime residence on Palm Jumeirah or a Downtown penthouse, full live-in household staff and a chauffeur, and international, evacuation-grade health cover including US access. A luxury car, near-daily fine dining, elite club memberships, private charters, and first-class travel. Dubai's ultra-prime housing, brutal summer cooling, and full staffing absorb more of this budget than a cheaper city would, but nothing here requires a second thought about money.
